supported connector/task access in that destination

decision.reason: The accepted design requires vendor-route feasibility first. Callback control and thread labels cannot prove native destination identity or computer authority.

officialSources.limit: This does not establish account permissions, an approved destination, execution completion or computer access.
officialSources.observed: ChatGPT supplies callback URL and signing secret; the event arrives in the subscribing chat. The inspected subscription interface supplies no native conversation selector.

officialSources.limit: Separate visibility does not prove strict memory isolation or same-native-Agent computer/plugin inheritance.
officialSources.observed: A dot can create separate visible cloud threads with work-specific context and coordinate them; relevant memory and notes can cross conversation boundaries.

officialSources.limit: The inspected page does not establish an externally selectable task destination with verified native execution authority.
officialSources.observed: Separate cloud threads and the dot cloud computer are documented capabilities.
